exact_statement: For every Boolean f on a finite uniform n-cube and K>=0, with G_f=sum_S fhat(S)log2(fhat(S)^2)chi_S, kappa=2/ln2, W_lambda(E)=sum_E fG-lambda|E|-(K/2)sum_boundary(E)f(x)f(y), and b_lambda=fG-lambda+(K/2)p_f, all W_lambda(E)<=0 are equivalent to bounded antisymmetric flows on both induced sign graphs with |F_xy|<=K/2 and div F>=b_lambda. The equivalence holds for real lambda. For every edit E, Delta D_K=(4/2^n)W_kappa(E)+R(E), where R(E) is the nonnegative summed Fourier Bregman remainder of k(t)=-t^2 log2(t^2)+3t^2/ln2. Thus an exact same-dimensional deficit maximizer admits kappa-flows and satisfies -W_kappa(E)>=2^n R(E)/4 for every E. For single-sign E, this slack equals unused outward flow capacity plus divergence-minus-charge slack. An actual three-bit majority at K=6 admits all kappa-cut flows yet has a same-dimensional edit increasing D_K by exactly 7; flow feasibility alone is insufficient for finite deficit maximality.
